page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6462C processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for networked applications. The hardware profile is structured for compute-heavy workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of high memory-to-CPU ratios.

Given its high core count, dedicated CPU allocation, and 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.hfc8i.16xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-bound tasks where memory footprint is secondary. Appropriate workloads include high-performance web serving, batch processing, compute-intensive simulations, and CI/CD pipelines.
